notes.title: Update 2.0 Patch 4 is live!
notes.notes:
What's new?
Hello Farmers!
Heres's the patch notes for the latest maintenance patch:

Sell Fixes
*Fixed a bug that caused selling items after each other to take longer and longer and eventually freeze/crash.

*Fixed some smaller performance bottlenecks when selling items.

*Modified the selling system that you can sell all the same type of item at once, you no longer need to sell for ex. joints one by one.

*When you drag an item from your inventory to sell it disappears from your inventory and shows up only in the sell panel. (if you cancel the sell or close the shop it gets back to your inventory)

Vehicles
*Flipped vehicles now should auto-reset and unflip themselves.

Game Mode Tweaks
*To further differentiate sandbox and simulation gameplay and playstyle for every sold item you get 2X the money in sandbox mode.

*Added a back button when you select a game-mode in a loaded save and click on the game-mode hints (there was a close button top left but it wasn't that obvious)

Multitool
*Updated the multitool's highlighting system to be more visually consistent.
The line from the multitool's end shouldn't break now.

Mistype
*Fixed a typo in the DeepChill Bud's description (prefect instead of perfect)

The update is now live, you might have to restart steam for the update to show up.

notes.title: Update 2.0 hotfix 1

notes.title: Update 2.0 - Time of day, Electricity System, Steam Cloud Save and more!
notes.notes:
What's new?

Time of Day
The game now features a fully featured time of day system! Apart from the visuals, this influences gameplay too. Your plants need sunlight to grow in the day or you can place an electric heater near them to grow at night. Lights have also been added to vehicles that turn on automatically at night. Also, you can sleep at night in your container to pass time.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36542892/2bc44a06df70926346a540301667a362b4fdc434.gif

Electricity
This update introduces a new electricity system! You can use solar panels to charge batteries at daytime and use electricity at night for lamps, heating your plants without sunlight and more to come!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36542892/62ca094e3f82bc90be08c0622a65e42c1a061bd3.gif

New grass and landscape rendering system, visual redesigns.
The game now features new landscape microdetails, redesigned landscape materials with more "3D" look for the terrain without the use of expensive techniques like tessellation, and fast GPU-Powered geometry shader based grass system with photoscanned textures.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36542892/254fa28160f9fac8c8dc07a312300ba02e2b44cc.gif

Major performance improvements
In this update aside from the grass, the whole tree and weed rendering systems have been rewritten. The game used unity's built-in game-object system for everything and while it was flexible, the performance was not enough. The new system uses GPU compute for batching and instanced indirect rendering done in a way that it's only transfers data between the cpu and gpu when needed. This means that you can grow a LOT more plants with more reasonable framerates It's might still not be ideal on some systems but this gives me a ton of possibility for future optimizations (for example jobified/multithreaded code, native datatypes, etc..) and i'll continue to improve on this as the game goes.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36542892/c909b1758042e47e416a25043c6b3c5db23a56f3.gif

New In-game and Main menu UI/UX
Complete overhaul of the in-game ui for options, main-menu, saves and more (the aim was to bring the look more in-line with update1's UI inventory ui changes)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36542892/6d1ae6a4648bc4da844307c37d689cf2cca12910.gif

Game Guide
The game now features a detailed in-game guide about the core systems and their workings with video examples so hopefully, you get stuck less often.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36542892/3f134bfb5d33b85c06e2b460d5e9ebcfaa3c2459.gif

Map Tablet
A drawing is now included in your default inventory. With this you can draw on the game map realtime, annotating where you want to make your land, what type of stuff goes where, etc..
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36542892/8a7527bb584755508fc33a9ffa8d809bf9780d74.gif

Reworked game economy
Each weed now has different sell/buy price and yield characteristics. You can decide on a per seed basis whenever you want to grow a lot for cheap, grow less and more expensive stuff, and sell for more or somewhere in-between. Each weed has a new base yield of buds that you can increase with fertilizer too so you can calculate if fertilizer is worth it for your plants

Reworkred save system with Steam cloud save
The game now has the option for multiple save files/"worlds" at the same time. You can start a new savegame anytime and manage all your saved games easily in the main menu. Plus your saves will automatically sync with steam cloud saves across multiple computers or when reinstalling the game from steam. The rework means a lot of the common bugs/problems with saves (container not where you left it, container is gone, corrupted game loads, etc) is hopefully gone!

Additional updates:
Compass
Aside from the map tablet you now have a compass that always points to your container's location so you don't get lost out in the open.

Smooth virtual camera system
Every camera transistion in the game now has a smooth easing, no more hard camera cuts!

Skippable tutorial
The tutorial now can be skipped in a new game so you don't have to complete it every time you start a save just to go away.

Saving&Loading Improvements
Saved games load much faster than before, upon saving a game the save button changes the state to saving and game saved giving you more feedback.

Inventory Notifications
If you are in FPV mode you now get inventory notifications if something is added to your inventory.

Steam Achivements
The game now has unlockable steam achievements! It's just a few for now but expect more in the future.

Radio
You can now toggle the radion on/off in the container

Menu navigation
You can now close menus and prompts with the ESC key (shop, inventory, planter management, accahments etc..)

Removing Decorations
You can now remove your placed decorations with the case same as with the planter sticks.

Car from cutscene
The car now stays from your cutscene where it stopped and stays when you load a game.

Fixes

FPV vehicle driving "headbobbing" fix
When you used a vehicle in FPV mode sometimes it bugged and started playing a nodding head animation, this was a bit jarring at times

Harvester not working
The harvester attachment now works like it should

Planter attachment complete rework
Reworked the planter attachment, now you can remove your seeds from it back to your inventory, close the planter panel with ESC, and upon saving the game your seeds in every planter goes back to your inventory and gets saved.

Scizor keeps cutting when holding the mouse button
The scizor now works as intended. When you click it cuts once.

Planterstick removal
Fixed all the issues related to planterstick removal. (When you removed a planter stick the land/ropes stayed, sticks not getting removed from saves etc..)

Fertilizer save
The game did not save your current fertilizer levels when you had a fertilizer in your inventory it always got back to 100%

Several other save-game releated issues
With the reworked save system most of the save-game releated issues should be gone. I'll keep testing this as i go.

PS. The weed grow speed is not finalized yet.
Because of the time of day changes I'm still evaluating what would be the best regarding this.

As always I'll keep working on more updates for the game, there's still a lot I'd like to add :)
This update took way more time than I initially anticipated, I don't plan on making the pauses between updates this long.
With all that said thanks for reading and Happy Farming!

notes.title: Hotfix 3 is now live! Performance impovements, detail options and fixes
notes.notes:
Hotfix 3 is now live for the game!
What's new:
*The first batch of performance improvements (optimized parts of the rendering system to reduce CPU-overhead significantly. This should increase your fps on lower-end systems)
*Detail distance option - Setting this to a lower value on lower-end systems should increase your FPS drastically.
*Detail density option - Setting this to a lower value on lower-end systems should increase your FPS drastically.
*Fixed a bug that caused the game to black-screen after a long play session or leaving the game idle for a while.
*Fixed the rendering distance for the ground where you plowed.
*Fixed that some joints had no sell value.
*Fixed a bug in the shop that caused to get 1 less or more item that what you paid for (x10 tobacco gave you x9)
*Fixed a bug that you can plant on the road as it was registered as a plantable surface.
*Partially fixed an issue where you can push your tractors with a jerry can or watering can. (This will be properly fixed in an upcoming release with a physics overhaul.)

I'd like to thank everyone for the bug reports, ideas and suggestions!
This will be the last "fixes only" patch for the game before the next update, I wanted to fix as much as I can before.
The next update will be a major update with new stuff and deep fixes (like update1 was).
I'm planning to add a lot and evaluate player feedback so it might take a longer time.
Of course, if there's a game-breaking bug in the meantime I will address it in a patch.

Thank you for playing and looking forward to the next update :)
PreyK

notes.title: Hotfix 2 is live now!
notes.notes:
Another hotfix is now live for the game.
What's new:
*Fixed a bug when the shop doesn't display the user's money upon entering the shop.
*Fixed an issue where the player's money sometimes wasn't saved correctly.
*Fixed an issue in the shop that made everything cost 2x the price.
*Fixed a bug that would make the player's money go negative.
*Fixed a bug in the shop that made the planter and harvester attachments were switched up.
*Added map bounds, you can no longer run to the map's edge and fall off.
*Added item sorting to the inventory. Clicking it automatically reorganizes your inventory based on the available free space.
*You can now resell your unused tobacco and rolling paper in the shop.

notes.title: Quick hotfix
notes.notes:
A new hotfix is live for the game.
*Fixed a visual glitch where if you stand in a place of a cut-down tree things disappear because of occlusion-culling and when you move they come back.
*Fixed an issue where not all attachments are available in the shop to purchase.
*Added a quick fix for when you run too fast high on the RunRunRun weed on plantable land you rarely can fall into the ground. (this will be properly investigated in the future)

notes.title: Update 1: save game, options, bugfixes and more!
notes.notes:
What's new:

Save and load system
Save and load your progress.

Game options
Igame settings for anti-aliasing, resolution and FOV.

Complete inventory system rewrite
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36542892/9417c8162fbd2a979c6bfb9031636c022339c2ea.jpg
Complete rewrite and redesign of the inventory. Bugs like the game forget where is what and infinite items/items disappearing should be fixed now.
You can also use the mouse scroll wheel to select the active item on the Hotbar.

Planter Attachment management.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36542892/172aba800e8e81c6dcc1e28c408f072f34ccfd7e.jpg
Now you can fill your planter attachment with the seed you want and you can plant it via vehicles.

Irrigator attachment
You can now buy an irrigation attachment for your vehicles. You can give water to a lot more plants with it.

Complete tutorial system redesign and rewrite
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36542892/74478e56aed059e57440ae75d301145d1e682d05.jpg
It was way too ugly. Plus now you get tutorial popups to recharge items with water for the first time.

Weed growing changes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36542892/811e0a3b234a6c98f6390d750a71a75c26b0ff0e.jpg
Weeds grow slower as they should. Plus the game now has fertilizer in the shop. You can use it to make your plants grow faster.

Weed high time
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36542892/4f6e5c247d36232a97ebacfe69ea8b65b5d643e6.jpg
The high time from a smoked joint calculates correctly and lasts way longer than in the previous version.

Other fixes and changes:
*Decorations and planter sticks now have collision, you can't walk through them.
*Replaced the car in the starting cutscene with a better one.
*Weed growing and harvesting optimizations.
*You can now sell a lot more stuff in the shop. If you run out of cash you can sell a few sticks from trees, you can resell your unused seeds, you can also sell prerolled joints if you want.
*added the character to the main menu
*options saved automatically upon setting them.
*rewritten Hotbar management.
*looking and walking when the inventory is open
*added options for temporal anti-aliasing and FXAA
*a lot of smaller bug fixes and changes

The update is out now!
If you can't see an update for the game restart Steam :)

Thanks for your feedback! Keep it going, I will keep working on this game.

notes.title: An update on the game's release date
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
First of all, thank you for your amazing support! Honestly, it's been overwhelming to see how many of you wishlisted my game, contacted me as a content creator, blogger/news site, fellow developer or just to say hi.
I'm sorry to inform you that the game won't hit it's scheduled release date of February 28.
This is my first solo project as an indie developer and I know this is early access but I want to do this right.
In short, I'm really close to releasing it but I need around a week to make some final polish on the first early access release.
I'm contacting Valve about setting a new release date in early March. This way I can have the polish phase, have a bit of headroom if something goes wrong and possibly a build review with steam.
Thank you again for all the support I got, thanks for your patience and I'm looking forward to releasing this game as soon as I can.
